# Review Report — PR #2043 (issue #2019)

## Diff profile
PROSE-ONLY change, 3 files (+19/-11): `skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md` (§1.1 tier-branch of the issue-body-cache authoring step), `docs/internal/implement-skill.md` (coupled mirror + probe rows 19/20 rationale), `.changeset/issue-2019-tier-branch-issue-body-cache.md`. No code, no new types, no tests. Small diff; not config-only; not engine-self-modifying (edits the implement engine surface, not the review engine).

## Executable boundary (all VERIFIED GREEN in this checkout)
- `lib/test/lint-worktree-fence-shapes.py` — rc 0; the local arm appends only a plain stdout redirect `> <absolute-cache-path>`, no command substitution / `$?` / same-fence-bound variable (AC5).
- `lib/test/extract-command-shapes.py --profile implement skills/implement/phases/phase-1-setup.md` — rc 0, no IR6 finding; the redirect target is a placeholder, not a literal `.prflow/tmp/` spelling (AC6).
- `lib/test/lint-reference-size.py` — rc 0, no finding for `phase-1-setup.md` (AC7).
No pinned prose wording in `lib/test/modules/implement-contract.sh` guards the changed text.

## Acceptance criteria
All 8 ACs satisfied against the shipped diff:
1. Local tier authors via stdout redirect to the printed absolute cache path; body enters no conversation. ✓
2. Local arm fails closed: non-zero fetch retries once; refused/no-output = unestablished -> existing STOP path; exit-0 empty not retried; whole-file read-back (non-empty, not `{`) unchanged and remains the single in-context materialization. ✓
3. Cloud arm unchanged (Write tool, no redirect, read-back). ✓
4. Tier keyed on `GITHUB_ACTIONS`; can't-establish -> Write-tool default arm. ✓
5–7. Three named lints green (above). ✓
8. Internal-doc mirror, probe-row-19/20 rationale, and the 'materialized exactly once (on both arms)' claim updated and consistent under the established counting convention. ✓

## Phase 3 findings
Four reviewers dispatched (type-design-analyzer and pr-test-analyzer gated off: no new types, no test-relevant surface). They converge on ONE observation — the local-arm clause 'a refused or no-output local-arm redirect fetch is an unestablished measurement routed to the stop path' reuses 'no-output' as a term-of-art for a matcher refusal, while a successful local redirect is also silent by design. Adjudication: this does not misroute — the paragraph frames empty output as the success signature and the exit-status + whole-file read-back is the authoritative arbiter; the wording is AC-sanctioned and fails closed. A second Suggestion notes the 'exactly once on both arms' phrasing overlaps with the changeset's 'two redundant copies' cost language, reconciled by the pre-existing convention (materialization = durable cache read). Both are behavior-inert prose whose sole reader is the runtime agent; under Phase 4.1.5 they cap to Suggestion/advisory.

## Verdict
APPROVE with notes. All acceptance criteria met, all three executable guards green, coupled mirror consistent. No blocking findings. The two advisory clarity notes are optional wording refinements, not merge blockers.
